name: Action
description: Represents an action to be executed in a PivotTable or sheet data.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns the name of the object. Read-only String.

properties.name: Caption
properties.description: Returns the caption assigned to the Action object. Read-only String.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Returns the action type. Read-only XlActionType.

properties.name: Coordinate
properties.description: Returns the coordinate property of the Action object. Read-only.

properties.name: Content
properties.description: Returns the content associated to the Action object. Read-only String.
